rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an ordinary walking cane used for support.

example.english: I need to rely on a cane when I walk.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 lou6 jiu3 kaau3 zyu6 gwaai2 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this for sugar cane as a crop or plant, rather than for a walking stick.

example.english: This sugar cane is very sweet.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gam1 ze3 hou2 tim4

rows.note: Use this for a rattan strip used in wickerwork or for the traditional cane used for corporal punishment.

example.english: This basket is woven from cane.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 laam4 hai6 jung6 tang4 tiu4 zik1 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the white mobility cane used by a person with visual impairment.

example.english: People with visual impairments use a cane when they go out.
example.traditional: 視障人士出街會用白杖。
example.jyutping: si6 zoeng3 jan4 si6 ceot1 gaai1 wui5 jung6 baak6 zoeng6
